sources.title: Katalin Karikó's Nobel Prize–Winning Work on mRNA Was Long Ignored—And Led to COVID Vaccines
sources.by: Katie Hafner, Deborah Unger and Gabriela Saldivia (Lost Women of Science Conversations)

sources.title: The scientist whose research was key to developing the COVID vaccines was demoted, had her salary cut, and threatened with deportation. Today, she won the Nobel Prize
sources.quote_checked: I was kicked out from Penn—I was forced to retire. | I also thought maybe I'm not good enough, not smart enough. | You persevere.

sources.title: Katalin Karikó
sources.quote_checked: When I am knocked down I know how to pick myself up

sources.title: "You Learn More From Failure—When Things Are Not Working Well."
sources.quote_checked: It is very well known that you learn more from failure—when things are not working well. | I have no special talent, no special memory, nothing. It is just that I can focus and work hard. | The only benefit you have in the periphery is the freedom that you are doing what you think is important. | for two years at Penn, I wrote at least one grant application a month and not one of them came through. | don't compare yourself to others.
